title: Briefing for 2026-09-24
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-24: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Here's what happens to the economy when Treasury yields soar like they are now. France’s wine production nears a 70-year low, leaving winemakers with tough choices. Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'. Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike. Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged. 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices.
global: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet. OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says. Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'. Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war. Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction. Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage.
philippines: Tropical Storm Surigae set to enter PAR on September 24. Impeachment court lowers conviction threshold | The wRap. Support pours in as Alex Eala starts Singapore Open campaign. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
